description: Agent-task milestone rows in the task-log panel (Phase 3b): stitch bound-model and session-end facts from the existing workflow-run session summary into the ops-log timeline, with a distinct accessible visual marker, agent-task gating, search/empty-state/download integration, and unit + a11y coverage. Pure Web additive view-layer projection — no runner/server/endpoint/wire/store/domain change.

tasks.title: Render agent-task milestone rows merged into the task-log timeline
tasks.description: Deliver the complete Phase 3b Web feature as one cohesive change. Restore session linkage in TaskProgressPanel (retain sessionName/origin.uses/classification, mirroring WorkflowView, and forward them into TaskLogPanel). Add a colocated agent-task predicate (isAcpAgentTask over origin.uses==='mohist/acp-agent' + non-empty sessionName) and a pure deriveMilestones function over the resolved WorkflowRunSession (model-bound from eventSummary.resolvedModel ?? session.model; session-ended from completedAt carrying status and failureReason). In TaskLogPanel, resolve the session via the existing useWorkflowRunSessions hook (no new endpoint), compute milestones transiently as a new colocated TaskLogMilestone/TimelineRow type that never enters the TaskLogPage cache or mergeTaskLogDelta, build a time-sorted merged timeline, render milestone rows with a distinct non-color-only accessible marker, generalize keyword search to milestones while keeping source-chip filtering ops-only, adjust empty-state guards to the merged timeline, and serialize milestones in the download export as [session]. Cover with focused unit tests for isAcpAgentTask/deriveMilestones, extend TaskLogPanel.test.tsx with a Phase 3b block, and add an a11y case for the milestone row variant. Preserve all Phase 1/2/3a behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: TaskProgressPanel projection retains sessionName, origin.uses, and classification (mirroring WorkflowView's workflowTimelineToStageStateMap) and forwards sessionName (plus origin, classification) into TaskLogPanel

isAcpAgentTask returns true only when origin.uses === 'mohist/acp-agent' and sessionName is a non-empty string; ops tasks (mohist/rebase, core/process, or no sessionName) return false; workType is never read

deriveMilestones emits a model-bound milestone (timestamp = startedAt ?? createdAt, detail = eventSummary.resolvedModel ?? model) when that value is non-empty, and a session-ended milestone (timestamp = completedAt, detail = status + failureReason when present, failed flag when failureReason is non-empty) when completedAt is set; returns [] for a null/missing session

TaskLogPanel resolves the task's session by joining task.sessionName to useWorkflowRunSessions(workflowRunId) output; a missing join yields no milestone rows with no error and no blocking of the ops timeline

Milestone rows are a colocated TaskLogMilestone type discriminated from TaskLogLine (e.g. via 'seq' in row); they never appear in the TaskLogPage cache lines and are never produced by mergeTaskLogDelta; the TaskLogLine/TaskLogPage/TaskLogDeltaEnvelopeWire shapes are byte-identical to Phase 1/2

Milestone rows render inside the same timeline as ops lines, sorted by ISO timestamp; when an agent task has no ops lines but a persisted session summary, milestones render as the timeline content and the Phase 1 'no execution log captured' empty state is suppressed (guard becomes lines.length === 0 && milestones.length === 0)
A finished agent task's bound-model and session-end milestones render from the persisted session summary alone, with no dependency on the Phase 2 real-time channel having delivered any event
Each milestone row carries a non-color-only distinguishing marker (dedicated icon + aria-label/accessible name + human label prefix such as 'Model bound'/'Session ended') that ops lines do not carry

Phase 3a keyword search applies to milestone rows (haystack = label + detail, case-insensitive substring) and hides non-matching milestones; source chips remain derived only from ops lines' source values and toggling an ops chip off never hides a milestone row
Download export reflects the filtered merged view and serializes milestone rows as '<timestamp> [session] <label>: <detail>'

Milestone rows pass the scoped axe rule set under packages/web/tests/a11y/task-log-a11y.test.tsx and the marker is verified non-color-only; any new interactive element introduced by the milestone variant is keyboard reachable with an appropriate accessible name/role

Phase 1/2/3a behaviors are unchanged: ops lines render, live-append via mergeTaskLogDelta, sort by seq, truncate, and terminal-state cache invalidation behave as before; existing TaskLogPanel, useWorkflowRunSessions, and a11y tests pass without regression
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes; npm run test:run -w packages/web passes; npm run test:a11y -w packages/web passes
tasks.output: Updated packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/TaskProgressPanel.tsx and TaskLogPanel.tsx (with colocated TaskLogMilestone/TimelineRow types, isAcpAgentTask predicate, and deriveMilestones); extended packages/web/src/widgets/issue-workflow/ui/TaskLogPanel.test.tsx with a Phase 3b block; focused unit tests for isAcpAgentTask and deriveMilestones; extended packages/web/tests/a11y/task-log-a11y.test.tsx with the milestone row variant case. All web typecheck/unit/a11y gates green.
tasks.notes: Pure Web additive projection — no server/runner/endpoint/wire/store/domain change; rollback is reverting the PR. Tests must use no real time and no real network: vi.mock getIssueWorkflowTaskLog, getWorkflowRunSessions, and onAgentEvent mirroring existing patterns. Design reference: openspec/changes/issue-339/design.md decisions D1–D10. Open questions (status wording: raw status text verbatim; marker glyph: filled diamond + aria-label='Session event'; failureReason rendered inline whitespace-pre-wrapped; show only resolved model with model fallback) are resolved per the design's leans during implementation.
